response_protocol.instruction: Read primary and fixed evidence. Request more fixed ranges when cross-section rules are needed. Propose candidates with exact source slices and literal case JSON paths; report uncertain/missing evidence. Return one impact-response-v1 JSON object. For action=read request fixed reads, with no final candidates or outcome. For action=finish state the unit_outcome, candidates and unresolved evidence. Cite only exact text actually supplied in primary/additional_fixed_reads or earlier user messages; normalized diff offsets are not original offsets. Case impacts must cite a complete version actually supplied in this call history. Catalog metadata is not text evidence. Use fixed_case_catalog and fixed_difference_catalog identities to request additional fixed evidence. Applicability is only a suggestion; deployment remains unknown and all candidates require review. Do not claim complete project coverage from this unit. Do not execute or change official records.
